name: Kapaga
description: Kapaga is a traditional Greenlandic card game belonging to the 'Crazy Eights' family. It is a fast-paced shedding game played with a standard 52-card deck. The game is known for its high interaction, specific localized penalty rules, and the central role of the '8' and 'Ace' as power cards. It is a staple social activity in Greenlandic homes and community centers.

content.text: Kapaga is a traditional Greenlandic card game belonging to the 'Crazy Eights' family. It is a fast-paced shedding game played with a standard 52-card deck. The game is known for its high interaction, specific localized penalty rules, and the central role of the '8' and 'Ace' as power cards. It is a staple social activity in Greenlandic homes and community centers.

Brought to Greenland by Danish settlers and Arctic explorers, the game was adapted from European Crazy Eights (Olsen or Mau-Mau) to fit local social dynamics. The name 'Kapaga' is a localized phonetic name for a similar regional variant.
Each player receives 7 cards. One card is placed face-up to start the foundations pile.
